headline: Marban Hollow Ignites as Clashes Surge Across Contested Northern Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, combat has flared sharply in Marban Hollow, where five base transitions over the past two hours and a neutral sector at Checkpoint Bua and Maiden's Veil accompanied an abrupt surge in casualties. Fighting remains relentless in Nevish Line, adding four fresh base exchanges amid heavy bloodletting near Grief Mother and Princefal. Weathered Expanse continues to see sustained clashes, logging three base shifts and over sixteen hundred combined casualties in the latest two hours around Shattered Advance and Crow's Nest. In Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf, ground combat reaccelerated with multiple base seizures at Leiri Hermanni and Breaker Town respectively. Meanwhile, the explosive fighting previously reported in Kuura Strand and Viper Pit has cooled markedly, though Callahan's Passage and Mooring County still absorb massive casualty tallies despite static base lines. Deep southern territories remain tranquil across all sectors.
